parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: ID of the user. `me` is also accepted for the signed-in user

200.description: true when the link was removed or there was none

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot manage users`.

description:
Removes the link between a user and their OIDC identity. The next OIDC sign-in with the same email links it again. The change is in the audit log.

Needs: a signed-in session of an administrator (API tokens are refused)
